title: Confirming what was reported
passage:
Did you tell the director the extra charge had been approved?
A. The director has the original estimate.
B. I told her we'd received the request. That's as far as I went.
C. Only the extra set of covers arrived this morning.
passageZh:
你跟主管說這筆額外費用已核准了嗎？
A. 主管手上有原估價單。
B. 我只跟她說我們收到申請，沒有再多說。
C. 今天早上只送到額外那組外罩。
